title: Start a session from the conversation without hunting for an execution profile
owner: Codex builder (Claude quota exhausted; user asked to use Codex)
origin: User report: Ask -> Generate plan -> 'Start session' disabled. Plan readiness needs_input [execution_not_configured]; plans are generated with execution_profile_id null (repoask/ask/conversations.py:398) even though one execution profile passed its test. The only fix path is Edit plan -> Execution and publication -> choose profile -> Save immutable version; the conversation card's Start session only navigates to the plan (thread.js:112, ask.js onStartSession) and shows the reason only as a title attribute.
decisions: Server: when a plan is generated, set execution_context.execution_profile_id to the default execution profile when exactly one non-deleted profile has a passed check for its active version; otherwise leave null. Compose it like plan readiness: ApplicationServices.enable_execution sets plans.default_execution_profile (callable returning id or None) only if unset; generation calls it if present.

Conversation plan card: when readiness is ready, 'Start session' launches directly (POST /api/sessions {plan_version_id, content_hash, idempotency_key}, key reused across double click / network retry like ask.js plan editor) and navigates to #/sessions/<id>. When not ready, keep it disabled and show the reason as visible plain text under the card (reuse plan-view.js reason sentences) with a link to the place to fix it (for execution_not_configured: open the plan editor's Execution and publication section).
No change to readiness rules, session launch validation, or the plan editor flow.
write_scope: repoask/execution/profiles.py (read-only helper returning the default profile id, if needed)
acceptance: A newly generated plan with exactly one passed profile is ready (no execution_not_configured) without editing; with zero or several passed profiles it stays null and the card explains why with a fix link
Ready card: Start session launches and navigates; double click sends one launch; a network error resend reuses the key; launch errors are shown in plain words
Existing plans keep their saved profile; plan editor unchanged
Focused Python and UI tests; full Python suite and full UI suite pass
reviewer: fresh Codex review session (opposite harness unavailable: Claude quota); coordinator verifies live
